cli.help:
Commands:
  (free text)                 converse: ask, check, teach
  fact(a, b).                 add a fact (initial status: UNVERIFIED)
  head(X) :- body(X).         add a rule (hypothesis)
  ?- query(X, b).             ask (conjunctions and "not" allowed)
  :proof fact(a, b)           explain why (proof tree + statuses)
  :conflicts                  detected contradictions and their resolution
  :sources                    known sources
  :rules                      active logic program
  :help                       this help
  :quit                       exit
cli.learn_offline: Offline mode: Wikidata cannot be queried.
cli.learn_unknown: "{topic}": no Wikidata item has exactly this name.
cli.learned: "{topic}" learned as {concept}: {concepts} concepts, {facts} new facts and {words} new words.
cli.opt_db: database path (default: $AXIOME_DB or XDG data dir)
cli.opt_learn: learn a topic from Wikidata, then exit (repeatable)
knowledge.constraint_seed_only: integrity constraints can only be changed in the seed
knowledge.ground_fact_expected: a ground fact is expected, e.g. is_a(cat, animal)
knowledge.not_established: '{atom}' is not established (which does not mean it is false)
knowledge.use_ask: use a query (?- ...) to ask a question
parse.expected_name: expected a name starting with a lowercase letter (found {found})
parse.fact_not_ground: a fact must be ground (no variables): {atom} (found {found})
parse.label_only_on_rule: a [label] is only allowed on a rule (found {found})
program.negates_own_head: rule {index}: a predicate cannot negate its own head
program.no_positive_literal: {where}: the body needs at least one positive literal
program.non_ground_fact: a fact must be ground (no variables): {atom}
program.not_stratifiable: program is not stratifiable: '{head}' depends recursively on the negation of '{dependency}'
program.unbound_variable: {where}: variable {var} is not bound by any positive literal
reason.closed_world_answer: relies on an absence of information (closed-world assumption)
reason.hypothesis_rule: the rule used is a hypothesis
reason.relies_on_absence: relies on the absence of: {atoms} (closed-world assumption)
reason.single_reliable: a single reliable source or several medium ones: {sources}
render.unknown:
I don't know: nothing in my knowledge base establishes it.
(Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence: I do not conclude it is false.)
